title: Silent Tokens, Loud Effects: Padding in LLMs
findings: The study found that padding tokens can unpredictably influence social bias related to religion. For the Llama-3.1-8B model, bias scores for the 'Religion' category fluctuated as padding tokens were added. In disambiguated contexts, religious bias noticeably increased with more padding, indicating that a seemingly minor technical detail can significantly alter a model's expression of bias in religious contexts.
